name: round1
description: The 39 data/raw documents that the round-1 index (April 2026, experiments/combo_a..combo_e) contained. experiment_runner.py --corpus round1 builds its indexes from exactly these documents, using their committed data/processed/<stem>.txt text (checked against experiments/corpus_pin.json).
evidence: Round 1 indexed 39 documents, not 42. Re-running round-1 retrieval on data/processed without popping_glossary, popping_history_timeline and popping_style_taxonomy reproduces all 25 recorded retrievals (5 combos x 5 questions) exactly: same chunks, same order, distances within 0.001. With all 42 documents only 11/25 match, and all 14 mismatches are exactly those three documents' chunks being inserted with everything else unchanged. Corpus sizes at 600/100 chunking: 39 documents = 1248 chunks, 42 documents = 1279 chunks. See experiments/round1_reproduction.md.
